AgentKit Core

Open-source runtime for building tool-using agents

What AgentKit Core does

AgentKit Core is an open-source runtime for building tool-using agents. It provides a scheduler, a tool registry and a trace viewer. It is a developer library, not an end-user application.

The workflow

AgentKit Core works inside the agent orchestration that the business already runs every week. Nothing about the existing process has to change first.

Pricing · About
https://agentkitcore.example/about:
About AgentKit Core

AgentKit Core was founded in 2025 by two engineers who previously built internal tools for operations teams. The team is four people.

AgentKit Core is self-serve: a business can sign up and connect its systems without talking to sales.
https://agentkitcore.example/pricing:
Pricing

AgentKit Core is Apache-2.0 licensed and free. A hosted control plane is planned.
